# CS-008: The proxy bouncer refreshes decisions often

- **Group:** CrowdSec and fail2ban
- **Severity when it fails:** low
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check reports `unknown`, never a pass.

## Why it matters

A proxy bouncer in stream mode only learns new bans when it pulls. With a long interval a fast scanner finishes before its ban arrives. The interval is set in the bouncer config, which also holds the API key and is not read; a last pull older than 60 seconds is the evidence used instead.

## Verify by hand

```sh
sudo cscli bouncers list (compare last pull with the current time); updateIntervalSeconds in the bouncer middleware config
```

## How to fix it

Use stream mode with an update interval of 10 to 15 seconds

## What a fix can break

Slightly more requests to the local API.
